identity: People and Things is an original 2021 duo for violin and soprano saxophone, approximately 7:30, Donemus 20245.
findings: Composition 2021, violin and soprano saxophone, two players, 7:30, eight-page score; commissioned by Femke IJlstra and Merel Vercammen for The Parliament of Things.
Composer lists the work’s premiere at Gaudeamus, Utrecht, September 11, 2021, with Merel Vercammen and Femke IJlstra; later performances include November Music and Dag in de Branding.
Composer work list independently confirms 2021, violin/soprano and approximately 7:30.
